title: Concept: BOM imported as an ordinary dependency
description: pom.xml declares a dependency of `type` `pom` without scope `import`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency of `type` `pom` without scope `import`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency of `type` `pom` without scope `import`.
